featured_reviews.name: Joslyn Estibeiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had booked this banquet hall. Mine was a catholic party. My daughter's First Holy Communion and my son's first birthday party. I shall share a detailed feedback which will help u all during your future bookings.

Service - (-5) minus 5 = 0
Extremely poor service. When u choose to book this place please take it in writing from them what they promise. I was promised welcome drinks to be served throughout. They immediately stopped within a round. They didn't have cold drinks to serve. My family were searching for the cold drinks. They had to arrange from outside. Such a big hotel running out of cold drinks is surprising. Now came the biggest disaster. When u book a party u expect that your guests should eat well. Here only gravy was kept chicken was missing. Guest were waiting for the chicken to get refilled no one cared for 30 mins. Finally our family member who noticed raised an alarm. In this way they assumed that we as a host are busy we won't know what the guest are eating. So it is very very important to keep one family member around the buffet counter. Starters were also barely served. They were extremely slow.
Now another very important point to know. I had requested for veg and non veg counter to be kept seperately. In the opposite direction as we all know if it's kept next to non veg everyone will eat. They made arrangements and forgot to set it up. My pure vegetarian Jain friends went hungry home and ate food from out. It was a shame for us.
